# Pagination

List endpoints return their page directly: the response envelope carries
both the entries and the cursor for the next page. There is no separate
iterator class — one callout fetches one page, which keeps each
transaction inside Apex's callout limit (D-131). Loop until the cursor is
blank (marker style) or a page comes back empty (offset style). The
schematic marker loop:

```apex
Box client = new Box(myBoxClient);
// `page` is the list endpoint's return type; it carries the entries and
// the next-page cursor. Pass the cursor back on each call until it is
// blank.
Envelope page = client.someManager.listSomething(/* …, */ null /* cursor */);
while (String.isNotBlank(page.cursorField)) {
    // handle page.entriesField
    page = client.someManager.listSomething(/* …, */ page.cursorField);
}
```

Each paginated endpoint's reference page (`docs/<manager>/<op>.md`, flagged
`Paged`) shows its concrete envelope type, cursor and entries field names,
and the exact loop — marker or offset — for that operation.
